content:
We need DBE for C14H18O3. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring O, halogens). No N. So DBE = 14 - 18/2 + 1 = 14 - 9 +1 = 6. So integer 6.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. But to be safe, we could call retrieve_dbe_formula to get formula. Not necessary but okay. Use tool.
